title: How many programs
response: There are **160+ programs** in the package, sorted by category: browsers, Office 2013 → 2024 and Office 365 packages, PDF readers, antivirus and security tools, media and graphics apps, archivers, remote access tools and everyday utilities for a repair bench.

title: Offline drivers
response: Yes — the offline driver pack is the core feature. After a clean Windows install, the panel detects the hardware and installs **chipset, network, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, audio and video drivers without any internet connection**. That solves the classic problem where the machine has no network card driver and nothing else can be downloaded.

title: Built-in updater
patterns: will my usb go out of date
response: The updater is part of the toolkit. It lists every application with its last update date and lets you download the newest installers straight from the panel, so your USB drive does not sit in a drawer getting stale.

title: One-click installation
patterns: does it install everything at once
response: Exactly. Tick the programs you want in the launcher and start the queue. The installer runs them in sequence without you clicking through each setup wizard, so you can work on another machine while it finishes.
followup: Do you want the full feature list before deciding?

title: Windows tweaks
response: The tweaks panel groups the routine post-format jobs into one click each: restore desktop and explorer icons, apply high-performance power plans, clean temporary files, manage OneDrive, adjust the Windows 11 context menu and repair Windows Update.
followup: Anything else you'd like to check?

title: Office packages
response: The launcher includes Microsoft Office packages from **2013 through 2024 plus Office 365** (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, Project, Visio) and free alternatives like LibreOffice, OpenOffice and ONLYOFFICE. Licensing the software for your client is done the normal way — the toolkit does not include cracks or activators.

response: Plan on a **{{USB_SIZE}} USB flash drive** (an external SSD or hard drive works too). A quality USB 3.0 drive makes copying and running the package much faster. The launcher runs from the drive, so nothing is installed on your own machine.
